notes.title: FEY is arriving soon!
notes.notes:
Get ready, explorers — our sci-fi adventure FEY is launching soon! Stranded on the far side of the galaxy, your mission is simple: find a way back home. But the universe has other plans — strange organic and robotic aliens are locked in a brutal fight. You’ll need to solve intricate puzzles, explore forgotten worlds, and battle deadly enemies to survive.

Our detailed environments and dynamic storylines promise an experience where no two playthroughs feel the same. Weapons, tools, and unexpected allies await those brave enough to search for them. Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare to journey beyond the stars.
